nodes.name: Iceman.json
nodes.summary: Pilot configuration for the 'Iceman' learned flight policy: defines a two-stage network architecture (a SIFU-style histNet that predicts dynamics parameters from state history, feeding an SVNet-style commNet that maps RGB images plus quaternion state to body-rate/thrust commands) running at 20 Hz, plus additive data-augmentation noise settings for training.
nodes.languageNotes: Layered JSON schema mirrors the sousvide Pilot's two-network design: a history/dynamics estimator (histNet) whose output feature vector conditions a vision-conditioned command network (commNet).

nodes.name: Jester.json
nodes.summary: Pilot configuration for the classical 'Jester' MPC-based policy, specifying trajectory planning (time-cost weight kT) and a 20 Hz tracking controller with state/input cost weights (Qk, Rk, QN), slack weights (Ws), and input bounds — no neural network is used.

nodes.name: Maverick.json
nodes.summary: Pilot configuration for the 'Maverick' learned flight policy, extending the Iceman-style histNet/commNet architecture with additional altitude and velocity terms (pz, vx, vy, vz) in the dynamics and vision-conditioning inputs, running at 20 Hz with the same additive data-augmentation settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Richer state vector (adds pz, vx, vy, vz) compared to Iceman.json, suggesting a policy variant trained with fuller state observability.

nodes.name: Rooster.json
nodes.summary: Pilot configuration for the 'Rooster' learned flight policy: pairs a SIFU histNet dynamics estimator with a DINO-based vision feature extractor (featNet) and a plain dnnet command head (commNet) that consumes DINO patch/class-token features plus the estimated feature vector to produce flight commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a pretrained DINO backbone (featNet) as a frozen/foundation feature extractor rather than the custom SVNet used by Iceman/Maverick, reflecting a scene-understanding-focused pilot variant central to the project's SUSVIED approach.

nodes.name: Viper.json
nodes.summary: Pilot configuration for the classical 'Viper' MPC-based policy, mirroring Jester.json's plan/track structure with slightly different orientation cost weights (Qk) for the 20 Hz tracking controller.
